title: 第十九章 摊牌拉同盟第二十章 主动签订主仆契
slug: 被弃龙崽崽三界仙兽都是我喂哒
lines: “你你你……
她她她……”
秦征弋看着玄稷你你你个半天想问点什么，看她才是一脸天真的稚童，就知道问也问不出什么。
下意识又问可能知道情况的范沐禾，才发现自己正因为她是大魔头互相对峙呢。
又着急看向玄稷。
“哎呀！小娃娃快过来，我不会害你的！”
秦征弋说着就往玄稷跑，想把她罩在自己防御罩内保护。
结果玄稷以为老头要捉自己很生气，反而紧贴范沐禾身前。
“我不过去，你吃了我种的东西，还想要打我的仙女姐姐，你坏！”
秦征弋着急想用强硬手段把玄稷隔空吸过来，但范沐禾的手已经搭上玄稷的肩膀，他吸不动。
范沐禾也是合体魔修修为。
但魔修肉体强悍，同阶，碾压寻常正道修士。
何况秦征弋还是以种植为主、法修为辅战力最弱的灵植修。
他跟范沐禾对上，根本没有胜算。
要是他大乘时期，或还可一战。
“难道你们魔修又想开战了吗？
虽然老夫可能打不过你，但你若敢伤我门下徒孙，我就是拼了这条老命自爆，也可重创你！”
范沐禾欣慰的拍拍玄稷毛茸茸的头顶，轻声安慰道：“不怕。”
她抬眼看向如临大敌的秦征弋。
“我若真想与你们正道修士开战，根本不会光明正大的出现在这儿，直接搞偷袭，你们正道修士死的岂不是更多？
你们还不知道是我魔修干的。
毕竟现在那些邪修，到处抓凡人、抓你们正道修士修炼，你们不也没有办法吗？”
秦征弋被范沐禾说的脸色极为难看。
也知道她说的是事实。
可他也没办法做到明知眼前一个大魔头，还无动于衷啊。
“你到底想干什么？
要打我们去外面打！”
秦征弋只是想请她赶紧离开宗门。
范沐禾直接翻个白眼。
“我说你这老头是不是年纪太大健忘了？
那我再说一遍，我过来是为了这小娃……”
“我叫小公主。”
玄稷听仙女姐姐又不叫自己名字，出声提醒她。
她想让所有人都知道自己名字叫小公主，最好让娘亲也听说到自己，万一娘亲先找到自己了呢。
范沐禾无奈的笑了，“对，我来是为了小公主的事。
你也发现她种植方面的天赋了。”
范沐禾说到一半停下话头。
content_en:
"You you you...
She, she, she..."
Qin Zhengyi looked at Xuan Ji and wanted to ask something for a long time. Seeing that she looked like an innocent child, he knew that he would not get anything out of the question.
Subconsciously, he asked Fan Muhe who might know the situation, only to realize that he was confronting each other because she was the big devil.
He looked anxiously at Xuan Ji again.
"Ouch! Come here little baby, I won't harm you!"
Qin Zhengyi said and ran towards Xuanji, trying to protect her within his own defensive shield.
As a result, Xuan Ji thought that the old man was trying to catch him and was very angry, so he stayed close to Fan Muhe.
"If I don't go over, you eat what I grow, and you want to hit my fairy sister, you are evil!"
Qin Zhengyi was anxious and wanted to use force to suck Xuan Ji over from the air, but Fan Muhe's hand was already on Xuan Ji's shoulder and he couldn't suck him in.
Fan Muhe is also a fusion demon cultivator.
But the demonic cultivators are physically strong and at the same level, crushing ordinary righteous cultivators.
What's more, Qin Zhengyi is still the weakest spiritual cultivation cultivator who focuses on cultivation and supplements it with legal cultivation.
He had no chance of winning against Fan Muhe.
If he were in the Mahayana period, he might still be able to fight.
"Do you demon cultivators want to start a war again?
Although I may not be able to defeat you, if you dare to hurt my disciple and grandson, I will risk my life and blow myself up, but I can still severely injure you! "
Fan Muhe patted Xuan Ji's furry head happily and comforted softly: "Don't be afraid."
She raised her eyes and looked at Qin Zhengyi, who was facing a formidable enemy.
"If I really wanted to start a war with you righteous monks, I wouldn't show up here openly and just conduct a sneak attack. Wouldn't you righteous monks die more?
You still don’t know that my demonic cultivator did it.
After all, now those evil cultivators are arresting mortals and you righteous cultivators everywhere, and you have nothing to do about it, right? "
Qin Zhengyi's face looked extremely ugly when Fan Muhe said that.
I also know that what she said is the truth.
But there was no way he could remain indifferent despite knowing that there was a big devil in front of him.
"What on earth do you want to do?
If you want to beat us, go outside and beat us! "
Qin Zhengyi just wanted to ask her to leave the sect quickly.
Fan Muhe rolled his eyes directly.
“I asked you, old man, are you too old and forgetful?
Then let me say it again, I came here because of this little baby..."
"My name is little princess."
Xuan Ji heard that the fairy sister didn't call him by his name, so he reminded her aloud.
She wanted everyone to know that her name was little princess, and it was best for her mother to hear about her, in case her mother found her first.
Fan Muhe smiled helplessly, "Yes, I'm here because of the little princess.
You also discovered her talent for planting. "
Fan Muhe stopped mid-sentence.
